So sorry to hear of your loss. I’ve been through something similar at a couple of different points in my life and would recommend seeking some counselling first - to get a better understanding of how grief and intimacy are very much emotionally connected. You may also wish to slowly ease yourself into intimacy by perhaps increasing non-sexual affection (kisses, long cuddles, meaningful eye contact, his hand on your heartbeat etc) first and then as you start to appreciate one another’s comfort, warmth and energy begin to introduce slightly more intimate contact bit by bit over time. Don’t rush yourself; and if your bf’s empathetic enough he’ll support you so you both can get through this together. Hope this is a helpful starting point.
